proof_0.key_move: NNRat.cast_def: unfold the cast as num/den, then cross-multiply (div_lt_div_iff₀ + Nat.cast_lt) so the goal becomes exactly NNRat.lt_def

proof_7.key_move: Translate transcendence degree into the algebraic matroid (AlgebraicIndependent.matroid_cRank_eq / matroid_spanning_iff) and apply Matroid.Spanning.cRank_le_cardinalMk
proof_7.notes: C ranks well but omits Matroid.Spanning.cRank_le_cardinalMk, the lemma that actually closes the proof.

proof_8.notes: No view leads with WfDvdMonoid.exists_factors, and only A mentions the unit-absorption trick (Associated.irreducible) while omitting exists_factors entirely.

proof_9.key_move: CategoryTheory.MonObj.lift_comp_one_right (the right unit law), after reducing the iso equality to its underlying morphism
proof_9.notes: The proof is `ext; simp`, so every view leads with ext/unfolding plumbing rather than the unit law.

proof_12.key_move: MonoidalRightAction.actionAssocIso_hom_naturality (naturality of the action associator), after rewriting the whiskering as actionHom of an identity (actionHom_id)
